question: A man purchased two varieties of pens at the rates of ₹8 for 9 pens and ₹8 per pen. If he purchased an equal number of pens of each of the two varieties and then sold all his pens at ₹6 per pen, what was his profit percentage?
solution:
**Given:**

Variety 1 Cost Price (CP₁): ₹8 for 9 pens

Variety 2 Cost Price (CP₂): ₹8 for 1 pen

Selling Price (SP) per pen: ₹6

Number of pens of each variety = N (equal)

**Formula used:**

CP per pen (Variety 1) = 8/9

CPₜₒₜₐₗ = (CP₁ × N) + (CP₂ × N)

SPₜₒₜₐₗ = SP × (2 × N)
